records.geographic_scope: Facility-associated Roseville location; municipal extent not verified
records.finding: The July 13 Bosch release identifies a facility in Roseville and reports sample production. It does not establish commercial acceptance or a city-wide manufacturing outcome.
records.next_artifact: A site/parcel-to-jurisdiction record, followed separately by a dated commercial qualification or acceptance record.

records.geographic_scope: County-level project context, not a municipality or facility boundary
records.finding: NIST locates the Edwards Vacuum project in Genesee County. The county label and the dry-vacuum-pump facility are different entities; a facility award does not describe county-wide capacity.
records.next_artifact: The facility's exact site and local permitting jurisdiction, with an explicit relationship to the county dossier.

records.geographic_scope: Malta-associated campus and multiple project components; place boundary unresolved
records.finding: NIST distinguishes new-fab, existing-facility and packaging work at Malta. GlobalFoundries lists a Malta contact address. These components must not be counted as separate places or treated as town-wide output.
records.next_artifact: A campus/parcel and local-jurisdiction crosswalk that distinguishes the component projects from the place identity.

records.current_title: GlobalFoundries Vermont: Burlington label and Essex Junction address
records.geographic_scope: Burlington source label; Essex Junction contact address; whole-campus jurisdiction not established
records.finding: NIST uses Burlington for the Vermont project. GlobalFoundries gives its address as 1000 River Street, Essex Junction, and the City of Essex Junction identifies itself as a host. Do not equate the Burlington label with the City of Burlington or infer the entire campus boundary from a contact address.
records.next_artifact: A dated parcel/site map and jurisdiction record covering the relevant facility before assigning a canonical municipal identity.

records.geographic_scope: Canton location label; town/village and facility extent unresolved
records.finding: NIST identifies Corning's existing manufacturing facility as Canton, New York. That label alone does not resolve the town/village distinction or make the glass project a place-wide production measure.
records.next_artifact: A site/parcel record identifying the applicable local jurisdiction and the specific expansion boundary.

records.geographic_scope: Proposed Sumika facility location; municipal extent not verified
records.finding: The archived January 2025 release names Baytown for Sumika's proposed factory. Its non-binding preliminary terms are historical proposal evidence, not a current final-award or operating finding.
records.next_artifact: An exact site/jurisdiction record and a later executed award or project-status artifact; verify these separately.

records.geographic_scope: Coherent project location label; municipal boundary unresolved
records.finding: The archived January 2025 release names Easton for Coherent's proposed expansion. Neither a location label nor non-binding preliminary terms establish municipal extent or accepted wafer output.
records.next_artifact: The precise facility and local jurisdiction, plus a separate later execution or qualification record.

records.geographic_scope: ADI fabrication location within a multi-site proposal; municipal extent not verified
records.finding: The January 2025 proposal includes Beaverton, Camas and Chelmsford. Its shared funding ceiling is not a Beaverton allocation, and a fabrication-site proposal is not a city-wide outcome.
records.next_artifact: A facility/jurisdiction crosswalk and, separately, an executed site-specific allocation or status record.

records.geographic_scope: ADI fabrication location within a multi-site proposal; municipal extent not verified
records.finding: Camas is another location in the same January 2025 ADI proposal. The shared ceiling cannot also be counted as a separate Camas award; later execution and geographic boundaries remain unverified here.
records.next_artifact: A facility/jurisdiction crosswalk and, separately, an executed site-specific allocation or status record.

records.geographic_scope: Hydrologic basin and managed project context; not the City of Yakima
records.finding: The August 6 release concerns the Yakima basin and Yakima Project water management. Its August 1 observations and July-to-September entitlement forecast are historical, not final delivered volumes or a City of Yakima outcome.
records.next_artifact: A basin/project service-area crosswalk and a period-matched final delivery ledger with the relevant entitlement denominators.
